title: The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A collection is never carried by visibility alone: it moves through a temporary institution of skilled people, decisions, files, permissions, deadlines, money, tools, and credits whose power should be made legible.
frames.alt: Title plate for The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.
frames.credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division
frames.alt: A color advertising lithograph presenting Butterick and Company New York fashions for spring and summer 1872.
frames.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · SEE — Who is actually in the institution?. Begin with people and entities, not an idealized org chart. Record each role, the work performed, employment or contracting status if verified, jurisdiction, decision authority, dependencies, and the evidence supporting the entry. Unknown must remain unknown.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who is actually in the institution? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · HAND OFF — What crosses between them?. A sketch, toile, pattern, specification, fitting note, approval, image, sample, purchase order, credential, or verbal correction carries different kinds of knowledge. Bind every consequential handoff to a named sender, receiver, version, decision, deadline, and return path.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what crosses between them? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · CREDIT — Whose labor becomes visible?. Public credit, legal authorship, ownership, compensation, and cultural recognition are different fields. Preserve the contributor’s preferred name and role while separately recording the governing contract or policy and any disputed or omitted attribution.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping whose labor becomes visible? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · TEST POWER — Who can stop, change, approve, or leave?. Map vetoes, approvals, revision burdens, payment triggers, confidentiality, reuse, termination, safety escalation, archive access, and correction. A glamorous credit list without decision and remedy fields can still hide the institution.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who can stop, change, approve, or leave? within The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Making invisible labor visible can itself become extractive: a house may display names while withholding pay, authority, safety, ownership, or meaningful consent. Some contributors may also need privacy. Credit is therefore a negotiated record—not a substitute for lawful working conditions, fair compensation, or power.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: For each handoff, attach the exact file, object, message, approval, or agreement that proves it.
